items.title: Chevron (CVX) Nears Venezuela Oil Field Deals That Could Expand Its Footprint
items.summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) is nearing agreements with Halliburton to invest in Venezuelan oil fields, including two heavy oil assets. The deals would expand Chevron's producing portfolio in Venezuela and involve Halliburton in field services and development. Chevron would become the only major US oil company with an active operating presence in Venezuela if the agreements proceed.
